dashboard.label: Cash-flow pipeline operations (synthetic lab)
dashboard.description: Queue samples are durable DB state. Counters are process totals, reset on app restart. Missing samples are not proof of health.

panel.title: Latest operational snapshot and sample age

search.query: index=main sourcetype="cashflow:operations" earliest=-15m | spath | sort 0 -_time | head 1 | eval sampleAgeSeconds=round(now()-_time) | table state pending waitingToPublish awaitingReconciliation failedPartitions publicationFailed sampleAgeSeconds

index=main sourcetype="cashflow:operations" earliest=-1h | spath | timechart span=10s latest(waitingToPublish) AS unpublished latest(awaitingReconciliation) AS awaiting latest(failedPartitions) AS failedPartitions

panel.title: Failure and recovery observations (not failure counts)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="cashflow:operations" earliest=-1h | spath | sort 0 _time | streamstats current=f last(state) AS previous | where state!=previous OR isnull(previous) | table _time previous state pending failedPartitions publicationFailed

panel.title: Latest per-process totals (reset on restart; do not sum samples)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="cashflow:operations" earliest=-15m | spath | sort 0 -_time | head 1 | table _time counters.*
